language_note: All 7 named Google reviews found (in the business's own IG review-compilation post) are in English; the business's About text on GlossGenius, its Instagram post captions and its IG bio are all in English. No Spanish-language content found anywhere for this business. English confirmed as the primary/default language.
founded_note: GlossGenius account created_at 2024-12-01T13:35:19.948Z (from the live __NEXT_DATA__ payload), consistent with a newer, smaller business (only 24 Google reviews, 13 IG posts, 30 IG followers).
phone_note: Confirmed first-party via the live GlossGenius __NEXT_DATA__ payload (business_phone field), matching the phone given in the task brief exactly.
email_note: Found first-party in the live GlossGenius __NEXT_DATA__ payload (business_email field). Not invented; not found on any other public page (the GlossGenius public page itself shows no email, and no mailto link was found on Yelp/Tripadvisor/Facebook), but explicitly present in the platform's own server-rendered data for this business's account.
address_note: Confirmed first-party via the live GlossGenius __NEXT_DATA__ payload (business_address field, with matching lat/long 26.6510993/-81.8581167) and independently corroborated by localheadspa.com's Fort Myers/Cape Coral head spa directory page ('2741 First St #110, Fort Myers, FL 33916'). A different, OLDER address (8595 College Pkwy, Ste 111, Fort Myers, FL 33919) and a different, area-code-941 phone number (941-946-8254) surface repeatedly on Yelp, Tripadvisor, ClassPass and several search summaries; 8595 College Pkwy is a shared salon-suites building (also home to unrelated businesses like Aveda Salon by Design, Tipsy Nail Bar, Chris Lewis @ Moxie per Yelp), and 941 is a Sarasota-area code, not a Fort Myers (239) one. This is treated as a stale/outdated listing from before the business moved into its own suite; the current, first-party GlossGenius address and phone (239) are used throughout this build as authoritative.
hours_note: Live business_hours object from the GlossGenius __NEXT_DATA__ payload (fetched during this build): Monday 8am-8pm, Tuesday CLOSED (working:false), Wednesday 9am-8pm, Thursday 8am-8pm, Friday 9am-8pm, Saturday 9am-8pm, Sunday 10am-6pm. This differs from an older 'Daily 10am-7pm, closed Sundays' summary seen on localheadspa.com/Yelp-derived search snippets; the live first-party GlossGenius schedule is used as authoritative since it reflects the business's current, self-managed booking calendar.
rating_source: localheadspa.com's Florida/Cape Coral head spa directory page lists PermabeauTea Head Spa at 5.0 stars with 24 Google reviews (re-fetched live during this build, matching the number given in the task brief). Independently corroborated by: (1) the business's own Instagram post compiling screenshots of 7 real 5-star customer reviews with first names/initials (David Walper, Lucy, Jessica, Katie W, Michelle G, Ronnie, David), all describing the service as relaxing/professional/amazing, consistent with a perfect rating at this small a review count; (2) a live Yelp listing and a live Tripadvisor attraction page both existing for this business with positive review snippets. Direct HTTP access to google.com/maps, yelp.com and tripadvisor.com review pages returned 403/JS-only responses in this sandbox (could not pull Google's own star widget directly), so localheadspa.com (a Google-data-driven head spa directory) plus the business's own published review compilation are the two corroborating sources used, following the same aggregator-citation precedent used for other builds in this batch (e.g. Birdeye for serrano-handyman-kissimmee).
own_site_check: Tried permabeautea.com, permabeauteaheadspa.com and permabeauteahs.com: all three fail DNS resolution (socket.gethostbyname: 'Name or service not known'; curl through the sandbox proxy also failed at the CONNECT/tunnel stage for permabeautea.com). The live GlossGenius __NEXT_DATA__ payload's website_url field is null (the platform's own first-party 'linked website' field, empty). The Instagram bio/profile summary (via web search) mentions no external website, only the GlossGenius booking platform. No website link found on Yelp, Tripadvisor or Facebook listings either. has_own_site confirmed false with multiple independent checks.
instagram_note: Real, active small-business account (13 posts, 30 followers per web search summary of the profile), bio: 'Japanese Beauty & Health Spa - rooted in ancient traditions. Combining scalp and hair special treatments, together with other mindfulness techniques!'. Used as the primary photo source via scripts/ig_photos.py (Railway ig-photo-service), which returned all 12 recent posts.
facebook_note: Linked from the business's own GlossGenius payload (facebook_url field). A public Facebook page 'PermabeauTea | Fort Myers FL' exists at this ID per web search, but direct fetch (both WebFetch and curl with a facebookexternalhit User-Agent) returned only the logged-out SPA shell with no extractable og:description or contact info; not used as a data source beyond confirming the page exists.
cta_channel: GlossGenius booking link used as the primary CTA throughout (nav, hero, all 7 service cards, CTA final, floating book button), matching the real (and only) booking channel for this business. No Booksy/Square/Vagaro/Fresha found. Secondary CTA is the real Instagram profile.
services_note: Full 7-service menu with exact names, prices and durations extracted directly from the live GlossGenius __NEXT_DATA__ payload (props.serverContext.publicUser.users[0].services), via scripts/glossgenius_dossier.py. One obvious source typo was corrected for display only, noted here for transparency: the business's own menu lists 'NOURISHING TREAMENTS' (missing a T); this build displays it as 'Nourishing Treatments'. No prices, durations or service names were invented; the source strings for 'REFRESHING  HEAD SPA' (double space) and 'HEAD SPA -XPRESS' (no space before dash) were also normalized to standard spacing/capitalization for display, with no change in meaning.

palette_note: "Tsuki" (moon, Japanese) copper-terracotta-on-indigo palette: accent-deep #d46d4b, accent-mid #b8634a, bg #090610 (near-black deep indigo). Derived mathematically from the dark-v2 skeleton's original gold palette (Pure Artistry) via HSL hue rotation preserving lightness/saturation: accent family rotated -26deg (gold ~40deg -> copper-terracotta ~14deg) and the near-black background family re-hued to a deep indigo (258deg, +0.12 saturation) instead of the original warm brown-black, to match this business's actual real-photo aesthetic: a candlelit suite with a projected crescent moon and starfield, purple/blue neon ambient light and a rose-gold/copper misting arch as the signature piece of equipment (see assets/hero-mist.jpg, about-moon.jpg, about-room.jpg). Chosen to be distinct from every palette already listed in templates/SKELETONS-V2.md ('paletas ya usadas': coral fairy #c04e62, caramelo #a86a2e, esmeralda #2f7d5a, teal acero #4fb8b8, violeta dark #b18ae8, rosa dark, gold dark original) and from DESIGN.md's mizu/amani/mare/alea/pausa tokens, and deliberately different from the other 3 head-spa builds in this same batch (which were observed mid-build in output/reflexpedi-headspa-palm-harbor and output/bonita-halo-bonita-springs at the time of this build, neither had committed a palette yet).
build_note: Built from templates/dark-v2/index.html via scripts/build_permabeauteaheadspafortmyers.py (anchored transformation script, one Python file, asserts on every replace, no freehand HTML rewriting). Nav/footer avatar: no real logo file exists anywhere for this business, so a text monogram ('PT' in the accent color) replaces the template's default circular photo avatar in the nav, footer and Experience credential pill, rather than reusing a treatment photo as a fake logo or inventing one. GATE OK on first full pass: python3 scripts/gate.py permabeautea-head-spa-fort-myers --lang en --forbid "Pure Artistry,pure.artistrysk,Orlando,Grant St,121705,silk press,K-Tip,Booksy,booksy". Zero em-dashes, JSON-LD parses, all data-es/data-en pairs populated (service names, prices and the business's own name are left identical in both languages per the 'do not translate exact names/prices' rule, since the site's default and only meaningfully-served language is English).
